original.statement: ApplicationSet controller reconciliation behavior changed to reconcile only once when an ApplicationSet is refreshed, instead of potentially multiple times.

decision.reason: [ev-bda8048cc6c3] is a one-line bug-fix entry saying the ApplicationSet controller now reconciles an appset only once when it is refreshed. Only environments that run ApplicationSets can be affected, so gating on ApplicationSet use is the right environment-wide condition. The evidence does not describe any narrower setting that triggers the duplicate reconcile, and it does not explain what 'refreshed' means. Confidence is low because the excerpt does not state the group and version literals (argoproj.io/v1alpha1).
